name: Safety pilot — one screen

replaceBeforeUse.countdownTarget: Replace 2026-08-01T00:00 with the actual incident-free start in the screen site's local time.
replaceBeforeUse.contentOwner: The customer's named HSE owner must approve every displayed value and notice.

config.headline: Hearing protection required
config.message: Press area 2 · until the end of this shift

playlist.name: Safety pilot rotation
playlist.description: Pilot content only. The Alert instance is scheduled content and cannot interrupt another item or an offline screen that did not already receive this playlist.

expectedBehavior: OpsBoard shows the four safety rows from its manual config.
Countdown counts up from the configured screen-local incident start without duplicating date arithmetic in OpsBoard.
Alert occupies the full viewport only during its 15-second playlist turn and then ordinary rotation continues.
After one successful online load, these static/manual app configs remain usable while the player is offline.
No item in this fixture provides instant, organization-wide or priority screen takeover.
